From 8ff2d7ca4a55dfabf12e876369835bd024eb4621 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Akshu Agrawal <akshu.agrawal@amd.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Nov 2019 14:36:17 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] i2c: cros-ec-tunnel: Fix slave device enumeration

During adding of the adapter the slave device registration
use to fail as the acpi companion field was not populated.

Fixes: 9af1563a5486 ("i2c: cros-ec-tunnel: Make the device acpi compatible")
Signed-off-by: Akshu Agrawal <akshu.agrawal@amd.com>
Acked-by: Raul E Rangel <rrangel@chromium.org>
Reviewed-by: Enric Balletbo i Serra <enric.balletbo@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Wolfram Sang <wsa@the-dreams.de>

diff --git a/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-cros-ec-tunnel.c b/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-cros-ec-tunnel.c
index 958161c71985..8a2db3ac3b3c 100644
--- a/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-cros-ec-tunnel.c
+++ b/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-cros-ec-tunnel.c
@@ -273,6 +273,7 @@ static int ec_i2c_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 	bus->adap.dev.parent = &pdev->dev;
 	bus->adap.dev.of_node = pdev->dev.of_node;
 	bus->adap.retries = I2C_MAX_RETRIES;
+	ACPI_COMPANION_SET(&bus->adap.dev, ACPI_COMPANION(&pdev->dev));
 
 	err = i2c_add_adapter(&bus->adap);
 	if (err)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-cros-ec-tunnel.c`**
- A new line was added to set the ACPI companion for the I2C adapter device. Specifically, the line `ACPI_COMPANION_SET(&bus->adap.dev, ACPI_COMPANION(&pdev->dev));` was introduced. This modification ensures that the ACPI companion field is populated when the adapter is being added.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug related to the failure of slave device registration during the addition of the I2C adapter. The issue was identified as stemming from the ACPI companion field not being populated, which is crucial for the proper functioning of the device. By adding the line to set the ACPI companion, the patch resolves the registration failure, thereby fixing the bug introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `9af1563a5486`).

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
bus->adap.dev.parent = &pdev->dev;
bus->adap.dev.of_node = pdev->dev.of_node;
```
Reason:
The ACPI companion field was not populated during the registration of the slave device, which is crucial for the device to be recognized correctly by the system. Without this association, the device registration fails.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
ACPI_COMPANION_SET(&bus->adap.dev, ACPI_COMPANION(&pdev->dev));
```
Reason:
This statement populates the ACPI companion field for the device, ensuring that the slave device is correctly associated with its ACPI counterpart. This fix allows the device to be recognized properly, preventing registration failures.
